name: link-checker
title: Broken link checker
description: Finds broken outbound and internal links in your published content on a schedule and lists each one with the page it is on and a link to fix it.

exclude.title: Links never checked
exclude.description: URL prefixes to skip: a full address such as https://example.org/private or a site path such as /members.

recheck_days.title: Days between checks of a working link

timeout_ms.title: Timeout per outbound request (ms)
timeout_ms.description: Also capped by what is left of the scan's time budget.
